description: List available OODS components from the live component-contract registry, with current trait usages and registry object/trait names including team definitions: business objects first, OODS Foundry's internal objects only when includeInternal is true, and registry.hiddenInternal counting the ones left out. Historical readiness evidence is retained with its original provenance. Filter by category, trait, or rendering context. Response includes availableCategories array showing all valid category values for filtering. Unfiltered, it answers briefly: each component's name, categories and one readiness label (proven-in-generated-apps when a runtime sweep's generated app used it, the sweep its evidence names; react-and-vue; or incomplete); detail summary adds tags, contexts, regions and traits, and detail full adds the evidence.

detail.description: Response detail level. Defaults to brief for unfiltered calls (each component's name, categories and one readiness label) and to full when filters are provided. summary adds tags, contexts, regions, traits and status; the evidence behind the readiness label is only in full.

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects in registry.objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them.

status.description: Filter by legacy static-HTML status only: 'stable' = mapped HTML renderer; 'planned' = HTML fallback. Consult productReality.surfaces for React/Vue, generated-consumer and maturity evidence.

name: catalog_list
